hook: Mark Chen has been at OpenAI since 2018, moving from quantitative trading into leading some of the company's most visible research programs. He co-led the team that built DALL-E, directed the vision work that gave GPT-4 its multimodal capabilities, and oversaw Codex, the model behind GitHub Copilot. In March 2025 OpenAI named him Chief Research Officer, a role focused on integrating research and product development so new capabilities move into deployment faster. He also coaches the USA Computing Olympiad team, a pastime that tracks with his own path through competitive mathematics and computer science at MIT.

standing.standing: Mark Chen is Chief Research Officer at OpenAI, a role he has held since March 24, 2025, according to the records. He joined OpenAI in 2018 after working as a quantitative trader at Jane Street Capital, where he built machine-learning models for futures and equities trading. The records credit him with co-leading the team behind DALL-E, directing the vision work that gave GPT-4 image-understanding capability, and leading Codex, the model underlying GitHub Copilot. OpenAI's own GPT-4 contributions page lists him as Vision team co-lead and Deployment lead, and the o1 contributions page lists him under Leadership and Executive Leadership. His current role is focused on integrating research and product development so new capabilities move into deployment faster. He also coaches the USA Computing Olympiad team.
